Update the launcher while keeping your existing Linux disk, desktop, apps and files. Shut down Linux normally, keep your data directory, and replace TryArch.exe. Do not use Start fresh to upgrade. Existing guests retain their installed external kernel/initramfs unless explicitly updated.

- Capture-friendly Immersive is now the default, including Ctrl+Alt+F. It leaves a one-pixel strip at the bottom to avoid the focused fullscreen black capture issue seen on the tested Windows host. In OBS Window Capture, choose Windows 10 (1903 and up); turn Capture Cursor off if needed. Other GPUs and Discord screen sharing have not been validated.
- Optional Discord Rich Presence bridges Linux apps that already have a Discord integration to the Windows Discord client. Enable it in Settings → Apps, then restart Try Arch. No new Discord application ID or token is needed. The activity status always reads `In arch-linux` instead of the VM account name; other app-provided details remain under the app's control.
- New guests include `try-arch-record`, a CPU H.264 recorder for compatible Wayland desktops. Stop with Ctrl+C; use `--region`, `--audio` or `--output` as needed. This avoids GPU Screen Recorder's unsupported Mesa vendor path; it does not change Ryoku's own recording buttons or provide GPU passthrough.

Older guests can extract **tryarch-guest-integrations.tar.gz** and run `sh scripts/install-guest-integrations.sh` as their Linux desktop user. Install dependencies with `sudo pacman -S wf-recorder slurp` if missing. The installer preserves unrelated files and backs up helper files it replaces. Fresh guests include these helpers; Discord stays opt-in.

The release pipeline boots the fresh guest, checks its Discord socket roundtrip, and records and decodes real Wayland video using the shipped CPU helper. Launcher tests cover upgrade preservation, privacy rewriting, preferences and fullscreen shortcut routing. A focused Windows OBS recording passed on the affected host; results on other systems may differ.

Windows 10/11 on Intel/AMD x86_64 with Windows Hypervisor Platform is required. The launcher remains unsigned and automatic updates remain disabled. Updating the launcher does not install guest packages or convert existing ext4 disks to Btrfs.
